.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-dis.name: Repository disk cleanup template
.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-dis.description: Removes disposable repository caches and build output to recover disk space.

.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-tmp.name: Old temporary files template
.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-tmp.description: Deletes temporary files older than the chosen retention period.

.bkit/templates/scripts/launchd/bkit-lau.name: Desktop app environment template
.bkit/templates/scripts/launchd/bkit-lau.description: Makes selected environment settings available to applications started by macOS.

.bkit/templates/scripts/prettier/bkit-in.name: Markdown table preservation template
.bkit/templates/scripts/prettier/bkit-in.description: Protects Markdown tables from automatic reformatting and reports damaged tables.

.bkit/templates/scripts/secrets/bkit-sec.name: Secret destinations template
.bkit/templates/scripts/secrets/bkit-sec.description: Declares which secret settings belong in each external store.

.bkit/templates/scripts/secrets/bkit-sec.name: Secret synchronization template
.bkit/templates/scripts/secrets/bkit-sec.description: Checks and synchronizes configured secret values across external stores.

.bkit/templates/scripts/serena/bkit-sere.name: Code navigation launcher template
.bkit/templates/scripts/serena/bkit-sere.description: Starts Serena with the repository environment for assistant code navigation.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-ca.name: Combined check result template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-ca.description: Decides whether the required automated checks completed successfully.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-de.name: Dependency security check template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-de.description: Compares dependency security findings with explicit, time-limited acceptances.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-machine-.name: Shared machine lock template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-machine-.description: Prevents competing test and maintenance jobs from using the same machine resources at once.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-test-awa.name: Keep test runs awake template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-test-awa.description: Keeps macOS awake while a command runs and releases the sleep protection afterward.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/lanes/bkit-re.name: Change comparison base template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/lanes/bkit-re.description: Finds the previous relevant revision so automated checks can identify changed files.

.bkit/templates/scripts/slop/bkit-slop-t.name: Suppressed-check detection template
.bkit/templates/scripts/slop/bkit-slop-t.description: Flags code patterns that bypass type checks or weaken quality gates.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Capability drift scan template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Finds competing implementations and callers that bypass a capability's declared owner.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Import-time work scan template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Finds files that perform work when loaded and counts the other files affected.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Capability diagram embedding template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Copies the capability register's package diagram into related documentation.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Missing import connections template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Resolves source imports that the initial code graph could not connect.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Capability freshness check template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Checks that the revision being pushed produces the committed capability register.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Code graph repair template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Adds resolved import connections missing from the generated code graph.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: User-facing capability paths template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Links user-facing requests to the underlying capabilities they reach.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Graph export template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Exports the complete code graph for external diagram tools.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Capability register generation template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Summarizes the code graph into package and module views and the capability register.

.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.name: Code graph commands template
.bkit/templates/scripts/graphify/bkit-gr.description: Coordinates local code scanning, diagram generation and capability freshness checks.

.bkit/templates/.claude/hooks/bkit-cloud.name: Cloud bootstrap template
.bkit/templates/.claude/hooks/bkit-cloud.description: Prepares a cloud Claude session with the project's required development tools.

.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-ac.name: Workflow exception check template
.bkit/templates/scripts/ci/bkit-check-ac.description: Checks event-dependent workflow differences against the project's accepted exceptions.

.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-dis.name: Machine disk cleanup template
.bkit/templates/scripts/cleanup/bkit-dis.description: Provides machine-wide cleanup of disposable development caches.
